_about: External calibration targets for the COPD module. Each target's `value` is what the generator is expected to reproduce; `source` is the reference that value is claimed to come from; `status` records whether that source→value link has been INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED against the cited paper. This file is deliberately separate from copd_generator.py so a passing calibration check is a claim about reality, not a tautology against the generator's own constants. Verified 2026-07-14 via PubMed for the four anchor citations; remaining rows are marked not_yet_verified.

_status_legend.confirmed: cited source located and the coded value is supported by it within tolerance
_status_legend.value_mismatch: cited source located but it reports a different value than the code uses
_status_legend.metric_mismatch: cited source located but reports a different quantity than the field measures
_status_legend.citation_mismatch: the cited journal/volume/page resolves to a different (unrelated) article; correct source not yet identified
_status_legend.citation_locus_wrong: author/year/topic correct but the volume/issue/page string is wrong; value still needs pinning to the real locus
_status_legend.definitional: value is defined by the model (e.g. a stage cutoff), not an epidemiological target to calibrate
_status_legend.unsourced: no calibration source stated in the module
_status_legend.not_yet_verified: source named in code but not yet checked against the paper in this pass
